# Qinyi Printing / Coinshin

> Dongguan Qinyi Printing Co., Ltd. (Qinyi Printing) and Coinshin provide one-stop manufacturing for custom puzzles, paper games and gift packaging, from design development and prepress through printing, die-cutting, finishing, assembly and packaging.

## Company facts

- Established in 1998.
- Located in Dongguan, Guangdong, China.
- Factory area: approximately 5,000 square metres.
- Workforce: more than 80 employees.
- Production capabilities cover design and development, plate making, printing, mould and die-cutting work, surface finishing, assembly and packaging.

## Product scope

- Custom jigsaw puzzles
- Kids' educational puzzles
- 1,000-piece and art puzzles
- 3D paper puzzles
- Custom board games
- Custom card games and playing cards
- Colour boxes, gift boxes and printed packaging
- Paper bags, hang tags and instruction manuals

## Markets served

Qinyi Printing serves artists, museums and galleries, tourism and cultural destinations, educational organisations, brand owners, gift companies, board game publishers, private-label buyers and promotional-product buyers.

## Commercial scope

Regular jigsaw projects typically start at 300 sets. Exact specifications, tooling status, sampling, price, available capacity, production schedule and applicable compliance documents are issued against the reviewed project brief.
